info.name: Hearing Improvement Mobile App API
info.description: Postman Collection for Hearing Improvement Mobile App Backend API (Django REST Framework, JWT, Firebase Social Login, Multilingual Translation, Account Management)

request.description: Authenticate using Firebase ID token (Google or Apple login). Automatically creates or links user and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Register a new user account with Email/Password. Generates a 4-digit OTP sent to user's email.
Verify 4-digit registration OTP to activate the user account.
Resend registration OTP to user's email if not received.
Login with email and password. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Logout user and blacklist refresh token.
Obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Check if an access token is valid.
Request password reset OTP email.
Verify password reset OTP.
Confirm new password after OTP verification.
Change password for currently authenticated user.
Get current user profile (supports Bearer JWT token or Firebase ID token).
Full update of user profile data (name, phone_number, profile_picture).
Partial update of user profile fields (name, phone_number, profile_picture).
Delete user account from within the mobile app (requires password verification).

item.name: Hearing Aid Wear Time & Hearing Health Score
Submit Daily Hearing Aid Wear Time (Hours & Minutes)

request.description: Log or update daily hearing machine wear time duration in hours and minutes.

item.name: Get Daily Wear Time History & Averages

request.description: Get today's logged wear time, weekly and monthly average wear hours, and daily log history.

item.name: Get Hearing Score (1-100) & Status (Excellent, Good, Average, Poor, Bad)

request.description: Returns single Hearing Score number (1-100) along with status classification (Excellent, Good, Average, Poor, Bad) acknowledging user's progress.

item.name: Get Today's Wear Time vs Goal (Hours & % Completed)

request.description: Returns how many hours and minutes the user wore their hearing aid today vs their daily target goal (default 8 hrs, customizable by admin).
Returns user's daily activity score scaled between 1 and 5 (1=Getting Started, 5=Outstanding) based on today's completed activities.

item.name: Get Progress Score Chart Data (Monthly & Yearly)

request.description: Returns graph-friendly progress score breakdown grouped for monthly or yearly UI charts.

item.name: Update User Daily Wear Time Goal

request.description: Get or update target daily wear goal hours for the user.
Renders Privacy Policy HTML page.
Renders Terms and Conditions HTML page.
Fetch all question 1 and question 2 choices and labels for rendering the onboarding UI.
Submit onboarding responses. hearing_journey takes 1 option, improvement_goals takes exactly 3 options.
Retrieve currently authenticated user's onboarding responses and completion status.
Fetch daily check-in question ('How are you hearing today?') and available choices.

item.name: Submit Daily Check-in (Good + What Went Well)

request.description: Submit or update today's daily check-in. When status is 'good', what_went_well text can be included.

item.name: Submit Daily Check-in (Okay + What Went Okay)

request.description: Submit or update today's daily check-in. When status is 'okay', what_went_okay text can be included.
Submit or update today's daily check-in. When status is 'struggling' or 'frustrated', why_struggling text can be included.
Submit or update today's daily check-in for frustrated status with reason why struggling.
Partial update of today's check-in (e.g. submitting what_went_well after status selection).
Retrieve whether user checked in today, today's check-in response, and recent check-in history.
Fetch list of active check-in tutorials, instructions, and video URLs.

item.name: Get Tutorial Details (Sounds Are Too Loud)

request.description: Fetch tutorial details, troubleshooting text, and video stream URL by slug or ID.

item.name: Get Tutorial Details (I Hear But Don't Understand)

request.description: Fetch tutorial details, video stream URL, and 'This still feels wrong' options for 'I hear but don't understand'.

item.name: Get Tutorial Details (Background Noise Is Distracting)

request.description: Fetch tutorial details and video stream URL for 'Background noise is distracting'.
Fetch tutorial details and video stream URL for 'Restaurants are hard'.
Fetch tutorial details and video stream URL for 'TV is unclear'.
Fetch tutorial details and video stream URL for 'I feel overwhelmed'.
Fetch tutorial details and text prompt flow metadata for 'Other' option.
Submit user's custom challenge text response when selecting the 'Other' tutorial option.

item.name: Submit Tutorial Feedback (This Still Feels Wrong)

request.description: Submit 'This still feels wrong' feedback when a tutorial doesn't fix the user's issue. Options: 'just_today', 'a_few_days', 'more_than_1_week', 'getting_worse'.
Fetch user's current week number (1 to 6), dashboard banner message, and active weekly tutorial details.
Fetch overview list of all 6 weekly tutorials with unlock, active, and completion status per week.
Get detailed tutorial content for Week 1 (Awareness).
Get detailed tutorial content for Week 2 (Adjustment).
Mark Week 1 as completed for the authenticated user.
Set user's 6-week journey start date (useful for testing week progression).

Returns all video playlists and tutorial videos across the entire application in one single API call (Overview videos, Daily Lessons playlist, What's Normal video playlist, Device Care tutorial videos, and Weekly program tutorials).
Fetch the Welcome Tutorial Video (title, subtitle, description, video_url, thumbnail, and duration) uploaded by admin.
Fetch the Check-in Overview Video (title, subtitle, description, video_url, thumbnail, and duration) uploaded by admin.
Fetch the Care Team Support Video (title, subtitle, description, video_url, thumbnail, and duration) uploaded by admin.
Fetch the Progress Overview Video (title, subtitle, description, video_url, thumbnail, and duration) uploaded by admin.
Fetch Today's sequential daily lesson containing video URL, audio URL, title, subtitle, description, and key takeaways.
Returns list of all active What's Normal videos (id, title, subtitle, thumbnail, duration, order).
Detail view for a specific video containing video_url, description, thumbnail, and duration.
Returns list of all active What's Normal audio tracks (id, title, subtitle, thumbnail, duration, order).

item.name: Get What's Normal Audio Details / Play

request.description: Detail view & play URL for a specific audio track containing audio_url, description, thumbnail, and duration.

item.name: Get All Everyday Listening Tips Audio List

request.description: Returns list of all 5 Everyday Listening Tips containing audio stream URLs, titles, subtitles, thumbnails, and slugs.
Fetch and play audio for '1. Reduce Background Noise'.
Fetch and play audio for '2. Face The Speaker'.
Fetch and play audio for '3. Take Breaks'.
Fetch and play audio for '4. Use Visual Cues'.
Fetch and play audio for '5. Ask For Repetition'.

item.name: Get All Hearing Aid Brands List

request.description: Returns list of all active hearing aid brands (Phonak, Oticon, ReSound, Widex, Starkey, etc.) with brand logos and model counts.

item.name: Get Brand Details & Device Models List

request.description: Get brand details and all hearing aid models belonging to Phonak.

item.name: Get All Hearing Aid Models List

request.description: Returns list of all hearing aid device models across all brands.

item.name: Get Model Details with 4 Sections (Cleaning, Care, Troubleshooting, Manual)

request.description: Complete device model detail containing all 4 sections (Cleaning Guide, Care Tips, Troubleshooting, User Manual) with text, manual link, and multiple tutorial videos.
Detail view for a specific care section containing text instructions, live user manual URL, and tutorial videos.

item.name: Care Team & Admin Support Chat System
Get User Active Support Thread & History

request.description: Fetch mobile user's active care team support chat conversation and full message thread history.

item.name: Send User Message to Care Team

request.description: User sends message (text, image, audio voice note, file attachment) to Care Team.
Get message history for current user conversation with optional ?since_id= query param for real-time polling.
Mark all care team messages as read for current user.
Get count of unread care team messages for the logged-in user.

item.name: Care Team Admin: List All User Conversations

request.description: Care Team Admin endpoint to list all user support conversations with unread indicators and status.

item.name: Care Team Admin: Reply to User Conversation

request.description: Care Team Admin sends a reply message to a user conversation.
